children.name: Datasets
children.description: Datasets for gripper manipulation, including single-arm and bimanual collection. Record acquisition hardware and processing methods alongside the dataset; distinguish reported collection scale from public releases.
children.description_zh: 服务于夹爪操作学习的数据集，包括单臂和双臂采集。采集硬件与处理方法随数据集记录，区分论文报告规模和实际公开范围。

children.name: Agent + WAM
children.description: Runtime architectures connecting high-level agents to world action models. Focus on command interfaces, responsibility for planning and memory, event feedback and failure recovery; record the low-level model and evaluated embodiments explicitly.
children.description_zh: 运行时连接高层 Agent 与世界动作模型的系统架构。重点记录指令接口、规划与记忆的职责分配、事件反馈和失败恢复，同时注明底层模型与已验证本体。

children.name: In-Context Learning and Tool-Based Control
children.name_zh: 上下文学习与工具控制
children.description: Agent architectures that use demonstrations, goals and interaction history as context to select parameterized robot-tool actions. Specify context construction, fixed versus updated weights, motion execution and returned feedback; distinguish numerical tool control from a learned WAM executor.
children.description_zh: 通过示范、目标与交互历史等上下文选择参数化机器人动作工具的 Agent 架构。注明上下文组织、模型权重是否更新、运动执行及反馈内容，区分数值工具控制和学习式 WAM 执行器。

children.name: Datasets and Benchmarks
children.description: Reusable dexterous-hand datasets, tasks, environments and evaluation protocols. Distinguish reported support, public assets and evaluated configurations.
children.description_zh: 可复用的灵巧手数据集、任务、环境与评测协议。区分论文声明、公开资产和实际评测配置。

children.name: Robot Demonstration Data Generation
children.description: Generate robot demonstration trajectories or training data from real or generated videos, retargeting and simulation optimization. Classify by the main contribution: online retargeting controllers belong under policy/control. Distinguish replay from closed-loop deployment.
children.description_zh: 从真实或生成视频出发，通过重定向、仿真优化等生成机器人示范轨迹或训练数据。按主要贡献归类：在线操控的重定向控制器归策略与控制；区分轨迹回放与闭环策略部署。

children.name: Robot Manipulation Policies and Control
children.name_zh: 机器人操作策略与控制

children.name: Action Policy Learning
children.description: Learn policies that generate robot actions from observations. When the main contribution is skill structure, transitions or sequential composition, use Skill Learning and Composition. Record tasks such as in-hand manipulation and methods such as RL, VLA and tactile fusion as visible labels and topics, rather than competing primary categories.
children.description_zh: 学习根据观测生成机器人动作的策略。主要贡献是技能结构、技能间过渡与序列组合的工作归入“技能学习与组合”。手内操作等任务，以及 RL、VLA、触觉融合等方法，通过可见标签和主题入口展示，不作为相互竞争的主分类。

children.name: Skill Learning and Composition
children.description: Learn reusable skills, skill structure, inter-skill transitions and sequential composition. Record how the skill order is obtained, how transitions depend on the next skill, and how completion triggers switching. Executing a given sequence does not establish autonomous task planning or generalization to unseen orders; human-video learning remains a method tag.
children.description_zh: 研究可复用技能、技能结构、技能间过渡及序列组合。注明技能顺序如何获得、过渡如何依赖下一技能，以及如何判断完成并切换。执行给定序列不等同于自主任务规划或已验证未见顺序泛化；从人类视频学习作为方法标签。

children.name: World Models and Planning-Based Control
children.description: Learn action-conditioned dynamics and use predicted outcomes to search or select robot actions toward a goal. Record interaction collection, action priors, planning and optional policy distillation; world modeling alone does not establish closed-loop control.
children.description_zh: 学习动作条件动力学，并根据预测结果搜索或选择朝向目标的机器人动作。记录交互采集、动作先验、规划与可选策略蒸馏；单独学习世界模型不等同于闭环控制。

children.name: Execution Feedback and Action Correction
children.description: Execution monitoring, action correction and failure recovery as the main contribution. Specify whether feedback changes commands, subsequent observations or model parameters. Ordinary closed-loop input alone does not qualify.
children.description_zh: 主要贡献是执行监控、动作修正与失败恢复。注明反馈作用于执行指令、后续观测还是模型参数；不能仅因策略使用闭环观测就归入本类。

children.name: Agent Architectures
children.description: Runtime architectures connecting high-level semantic/geometric planning or agents to reusable dexterous-hand execution backends. Record skill interfaces, planning and memory responsibilities, the actual low-level controller, and whether feedback triggers low-level phase switching or high-level replanning/recovery. Task planning, skill composition and recovery are visible tags rather than nested categories.
children.description_zh: 运行时连接高层语义／几何规划或 Agent 与可复用灵巧手执行器的系统架构。记录技能接口、规划与记忆职责、实际底层控制器，并区分反馈仅触发低层阶段切换，还是支持高层重规划与恢复。任务规划、技能编排和失败恢复作为可见标签，不单独设置下级分类。

children.name: Human Hand Motion and Manipulation Video Modeling
children.name_zh: 人手动作与操作视频建模
children.description: Supporting research on human hand/camera trajectories and manipulation videos: reconstruction, prediction and instruction-conditioned generation. Distinguish human representations and robot retargeting demonstrations from directly learned closed-loop robot control.
children.description_zh: 以人手／相机轨迹和操作视频为对象，研究运动重建、未来预测与指令条件生成。作为灵巧手支撑研究收录；区分人手表示、机器人重定向演示和直接学习的闭环机器人控制。

children.name: Execution Efficiency and Temporal Control
children.description: Methods for faster task execution through action timing, temporal granularity and scheduling across manipulation platforms. Record evaluated backbones and embodiments; distinguish execution speed from model inference latency.
children.description_zh: 通过动作节奏、时间粒度与调度提高任务执行效率的操作共性方法。记录已验证基座与本体，区分动作执行加速和模型推理加速。

children.name: RL Training and Exploration
children.description: Reusable RL training mechanisms such as curriculum learning, task/reset sampling and exploration allocation. Record what training distribution changes, how configurations are supplied, the underlying policy optimizer, evaluated embodiments and deployment policy. Distinguish a general training contribution from a task-specific policy that uses RL; sampling existing resets does not generate new configurations.
children.description_zh: 可复用的强化学习训练机制，包括课程学习、任务／重置采样与探索资源分配。注明改变哪部分训练分布、配置如何提供、底层策略优化器、验证本体及部署策略；区分共性训练贡献与使用 RL 的具体任务策略，从已有重置池采样不等同于生成新配置。

children.name: Navigation Action Models
children.description: Includes point-goal, object-goal, and language-guided navigation, exploration, and navigation trajectory generation. The focus is reaching or finding a target using environmental observations; locomotion execution can be linked as a related area.
children.description_zh: 包括点目标导航、物体目标导航、语言导航、探索与导航轨迹生成。重点是利用环境观测到达或找到目标；涉及行走执行时，可关联身体运动与全身控制板块。

children.name: Body Motion and Whole-Body Control Models
children.name_zh: 身体运动与全身控制模型

children.name: Bimanual and Torso-Assisted Manipulation
children.description: Manipulate objects through coordinated arm motions and support from the torso or other upper-body surfaces, including holding, regrasping and on-body object transfer. Record the learned policy outputs and the independent controllers used for the waist, legs, balance or locomotion; placement here does not imply unified whole-body actuation.
children.description_zh: 通过双臂运动与躯干等上身表面的支撑协同完成抱持、换抱及物体在身体周围的转移。明确学习策略的输出自由度，以及腰腿、平衡或行走由何种独立控制器负责；本类不默认等同于统一全身关节控制。
